label: Project or team — Slack-style organisation
summary: Announcements, team channels and written stand-ups, meeting rooms with screen sharing, and a proximity virtual office.
notes: Without accounts the server stores no chat: somebody new gets past messages from members who share their history. With accounts, members can also keep end-to-end-encrypted copies on the server.
Add a channel per team or topic as the project grows.
Posting in an announcement channel takes an admin (the admin token) or, on a server with accounts, a moderator.
